conviction_note: Q1 delivered 51.5% of an H1 OP plan that needed only a -4.8% YoY Q2, and 旧盆 moved back into August (planned) with a strong July, so H1 most likely beats plan by 5-10% and lands about at to slightly above the IFIS H1 consensus (ordinary 9,750); San-A held its full-year at H1 in 2024 and 2025, so a hold below the street's 18,820 is the base case. August typhoons (all main-island stores shut 8/7; 18号 during 旧盆) and a September monthly that will print weak on the 旧盆 shift are the offsets. Findings sum +0.6; the scaled number is (2*0.56-1)*3.5 = +0.42, close to it because both rest on a modest positive lean on partly-priced numbers.
bar: IFIS consensus H1 (Mar-Aug 2026) ordinary profit 9,750m yen and full-year 18,820m yen, via kabuyoho (IFIS) https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=2659 ; company H1 plan OP 9,026 / ordinary 9,353, full-year OP 17,527 / ordinary 17,975, held at Q1 (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/26590/081220260706588349_tse-qcedjpsm-26590-20260707326590-ixbrl.htm). Only one estimate source, so sizes are kept small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: no disclosed position >=0.5% (0.0%, unchanged, as of 2026-09-29, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 1.99 (kabutan, 2026-10-06), moderate, not a crowded margin long. No skew exists. Run-up -6.03% over 20 sessions and -2.29% over 5 into the print; priced_lean_pct +0.15. Company buyback active: 384,300 shares / 1.29bn yen bought in September, 9.10bn of a 15bn programme done by 2026-09-30.

findings.finding: Q1 (Mar-May) OP 4,644m was 51.5% of the H1 OP plan of 9,026m, against 45.1% in FY2025.02 (Q1 4,134 / H1 9,170, 旧盆 in August as this year) and 47.1% in FY2026.02 (4,101 / 8,706, 旧盆 in September); the H1 plan was not raised at Q1 and implies Q2 OP of only 4,382m, below last year's weak 4,605m, while the company's own Q2 existing-store plan is +6.6%. H1 most likely lands at roughly 9,400-9,900m OP, 4-10% above plan and about in line to slightly above the IFIS H1 ordinary consensus of 9,750m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2024 (OP 9,170, +8.6% YoY, 旧盆 in August) was followed by an estimated +7.59% reaction (2024-10-07); H1 2025 missed its own plan (OP 96.4% of budget) and drew an estimated -2.91% (2025-10-08); Q1 2026 (OP +13.2%) rose into the 15:00 release and closed +4.32% (kabutan 2026-07-07).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the IFIS H1 consensus (9,750 ordinary) already sits 4% above the company plan, so a plan beat alone is expected. What is not obviously priced is the size: the own-history progress rate in a year with 旧盆 in August points to ordinary profit above 9,750, and the stock has fallen 6% over 20 sessions into the print rather than running up, which is not what a market leaning on an upside H1 looks like.
findings.independence: Company plan and Q1 numbers from the Q1 短信 https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/26590/081220260706588349_tse-qcedjpsm-26590-20260707326590-ixbrl.htm ; Q2 existing-store plan 106.6% and the 旧盆 shift (2026-08-25 to 27 vs 2025-09-04 to 06) from the FY results deck https://www.san-a.co.jp/common/uploads/2026/04/82e421f8e2b190aa544aa5fded630257.pdf ; Okasan upgraded to 強気 TP 3,750 on 2026-08-06 https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2659&b=n202608061499

findings.finding: July 2026 was strong for Okinawa retail: the Cabinet Office economy watcher survey has supermarkets above prior year on sunny weather and home-appliance stores boosted by pre-standard 駆け込み demand plus the おきなわ省エネ家電購入応援キャンペーン, and July tourist arrivals were a July record (963,900, +1.7%). San-A's 住関 line (incl. its Edion franchise) ran 89.8% and 91.6% of prior year in July/August 2025 precisely because it was lapping the previous campaign, so Q2 2026 has an easy, campaign-supported comparison there.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025 H1 deck blamed the 住関 decline (anniversary of the prior appliance campaign) and weather for the H1 miss that drew an estimated -2.91%; the reverse has not been observed.
findings.why_not_priced: Regional survey and tourism data are not read through to San-A by most of the coverage, and San-A publishes no 月次, so the quarter is not visible before the release; if the market held it the stock would not have drifted down 6% into the print. It is a proxy, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Prior-year 住関 monthly figures and the campaign comparison from San-A's own FY2026.02 H1 deck https://www.san-a.co.jp/common/uploads/2025/10/1b1ff2ff26a5ea6e4660f2d44d3111f0.pdf ; July tourist record from Okinawa prefecture https://www.pref.okinawa.jp/_res/projects/default_project/_page_/001/026/300/r8-7gaikyou-sokuhou.pdf

findings.finding: August 2026 was disrupted by two typhoons: San-A closed every main-island store on 2026-08-07 for 台風13号, 台風18号 hit on 2026-08-25/26 in the middle of 旧盆 (San-A stayed open), August tourist arrivals fell 14.0% YoY to 923,900, and the economy watcher supermarket respondent reports a temporary drop in consumption. This works against the company's demanding Q2 existing-store plan of 106.6%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not separable; the May 2026 typhoon approach was cited as a sales positive (food stocking) in the Q1 release that drew +4.32%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: typhoons and tourist numbers are public and the stock has fallen 6% in 20 sessions, which is consistent with holders having marked August down. Store closures also pull food demand forward, so the net effect on a supermarket is smaller than the tourist drop suggests.
findings.independence: Store closure: Ryukyu Shimpo typhoon coverage and search snippet of San-A's 8/7 closure https://ryukyushimpo.jp/tag/%e5%8f%b0%e9%a2%a813%e5%8f%b7 ; typhoon 18 during 旧盆: https://ryukyushimpo.jp/national/entry-5480962.html ; economy watcher Aug: https://www5.cao.go.jp/keizai3/2026/0908watcher/gen_okinawa.pdf

findings.finding: San-A held its full-year forecast at the H1 print in both 2024 and 2025 (only 2023 was revised, by a separate pre-release on 2023-09-29), and no 業績予想の修正 has been filed this year; the IFIS full-year ordinary consensus of 18,820m sits 4.7% above the company's 17,975m, so the base case is a hold below the street, with no positive guidance catalyst.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Holds at H1 2024 and H1 2025 drew estimated +7.59% and -2.91%, i.e. the H1 number, not the hold, set the sign.
findings.why_not_priced: The hold habit is visible in the revision history, so most of this is priced; the residual is that a street sitting above plan gets no confirmation. Small either way, with upside tail if management does raise after a 51.5% Q1 progress rate.

findings.finding: The H1 results deck carries September monthly sales (the FY2026.02 H1 deck added '9月実績込み', where September 2025 printed existing-store 110.0% on 旧盆), so today's release will show September 2026 against that 110% comparison with 旧盆 moved to August and 台風26号 on 2026-09-27/28: optically a sharp decline, though inside the company's Q3 existing-store plan of 101.6%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last year's H1 deck showed a strong September (110.0%) and the stock still fell an estimated -2.91%, so the September line has not set the sign.
findings.why_not_priced: The September number is new information released with the print; but the calendar shift is spelled out in the company's own plan, so it lands inside guidance and is sized near zero.
findings.independence: Q3 plan 101.6% and 旧盆 dates in the FY deck https://www.san-a.co.jp/common/uploads/2026/04/82e421f8e2b190aa544aa5fded630257.pdf ; typhoon 26 coverage https://ryukyushimpo.jp/tag/%e5%8f%b0%e9%a2%a813%e5%8f%b7

findings.finding: The 15bn yen / 7m share buyback (to 2027-02-26) has 5.9bn yen left after 9.10bn bought by 2026-09-30, about 1.2bn yen a month of market buying (~10% of the 603m yen median daily turnover) continuing through the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The buyback's announcement with the FY print drew an estimated +9.18% (2026-04-07).
findings.why_not_priced: Known and mostly priced; what it adds is a steady bid that cushions a disappointing reaction. No year-end dividend change (110 yen, no interim) is expected at H1.
findings.independence: Same programme in the FY deck https://www.san-a.co.jp/common/uploads/2026/04/82e421f8e2b190aa544aa5fded630257.pdf

baseline_tension: Cuts mildly against the run-up: the stock fell 6% over 20 sessions into a print whose H1 most likely beats plan and meets the street, with no disclosed shorts and a modest 信用倍率 of 1.99; the strongest positive the release could carry is an H1 beat plus a full-year raise (looked for: San-A's habit says hold), and the buyback is already running, so the lean is positive but small.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (negative resting on a public series): the August typhoon/tourist finding rests on public prefecture and press data the price has had for weeks, so it was shrunk from -0.5 to -0.3.
Core table (lands inside what the company guided): the September-monthly finding falls inside the company's own Q3 plan of 101.6% with the 旧盆 shift spelled out, so it was moved from -0.3 to -0.2.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): checked; the set is not negative-tilted, and the strongest positive (H1 beat plus a possible full-year raise, buyback) was looked for and is written in baseline_tension. p_up moved from 55 to 56 as the negatives shrank; abs_move_pct unchanged at 3.5.
